cues.en: Hello, my friends and welcome to this new hands-on tutorial on deployment endpoints in Amazon SageMaker.
cues.zh: 朋友們好，歡迎來到 SageMaker 部署端點實作。

cues.en: Indeed, in the previous tutorial we deployed our two machine learning models, our regression model and our classification model, which created two endpoints, one for each of these two models.
cues.zh: 先前部署迴歸、分類模型，各建立一個端點。

cues.en: And now in this tutorial, we're going to understand how we can reuse these endpoints to make new predictions, whether it is in a code or in an application
cues.zh: 現在理解如何用端點做新預測，不論程式碼或應用，

cues.en: where you invoke your deploy model to make new predictions, you will always use this endpoint for the invocation in inference mode.
cues.zh: 呼叫部署模型做推論，都會使用端點。

cues.en: Okay, so first thing first, let me just quickly remind where you can find your endpoint.
cues.zh: 先快速提醒位置。

cues.en: It's actually not in my models feature of Canvas but in ML OPS, which stands for ML Operations.
cues.zh: 不是 Canvas 的 My models，而是 MLOps，Machine Learning Operations。

cues.en: Whenever you have a deployed model, you usually use it in a machine learning operation, like a machine learning pipeline to automatically make new predictions as the data comes in.
cues.zh: 部署模型通常放進機器學習維運，例如管線隨資料到來自動預測。

cues.en: And so there we go, inside the ML OPS feature of Canvas, you go to deployments where you will find your deployments, your endpoint for each of the two models.
cues.zh: Canvas 的 MLOps、Deployments，能找到兩個模型的端點與部署。

cues.en: And here you have the deployment URL, which will point basically to the location of your deployed model thanks to that endpoint.
cues.zh: Deployment URL 指向端點，也就是部署模型的位置。

cues.en: Okay, so I'm going to show you a few things here.
cues.zh: 展示幾件事。

cues.en: First, I'm going to show you a sample code showing more or less how you can call, you know, invoke your deployed machine learning model in a code, you know, in order to make new predictions.
cues.zh: 先看範例碼，大致如何在程式呼叫已部署模型，做新預測。

cues.en: So to find this, we can click the three little dots here, then click view details on our deployed regression model, and then click view sample code, and there you go.
cues.zh: 按三個點、View details，進已部署迴歸，再 View sample code。

cues.en: This is how you would invoke your deployed machine learning model in a code, okay?
cues.zh: 這就是在程式呼叫模型的方法。

cues.en: Through the Boto3 library, you call first the SageMaker runtime, then in the body here you are going to input the feature values of the new observations
cues.zh: 用 Boto3，先建立 SageMaker runtime，body 裡輸入新觀測的特徵值，

cues.en: for which you want to make a prediction.
cues.zh: 也就是想預測的資料。

cues.en: And then in the response, you're gonna have the invocation of your model, which will return the prediction, okay?
cues.zh: response 會包含呼叫模型回傳的預測。

cues.en: So this is how you would use your endpoint in a code.
cues.zh: 這是程式中的端點用法。

cues.en: Now, it doesn't have to be always in a code, it can be in any application, in which case you would use the deployment URL of your endpoint in order to once again invoke your machine learning model.
cues.zh: 不一定要單獨程式，也可在應用使用端點 Deployment URL 呼叫模型。

cues.en: And then what I'd like to show you as well is that you can test the deployment of your machine learning model.
cues.zh: 也想展示測試部署。

cues.en: Here we are on our regression deployed model.
cues.zh: 這是已部署迴歸。

cues.en: And so there we go, once again similarly to the predict step when building the machine learning model in the previous section, well here we can enter some values.
cues.zh: 和上一節建模的 Predict 相似，可輸入一些值。

cues.en: Okay, so I'm going to enter an ambient temperature of 30 degrees for example, then an exhaust vacuum of 40,
cues.zh: 例如環境溫度 30 度、排氣真空度 40，

cues.en: then an ambient pressure of let's say 1050, and then a relative humidity of 110, okay?
cues.zh: 環境壓力 1050、相對濕度 110。

cues.en: And once again, we can just get the new prediction by simply clicking update prediction, and we will get the predicted net electrical energy output,
cues.zh: 只按 Update prediction，取得預測淨發電量，

cues.en: which here is predicted to be 433.508, okay?
And we got that prediction from our deployed model.
cues.zh: 來自已部署模型。

cues.en: Now, let's quickly do the same for the classification model to predict if the breast cancer tumor of a particular patient with particular breast features is benign or malignant.
cues.zh: 快速對分類做同樣事情，預測特定病患、特定乳房特徵下，腫瘤良性或惡性。

cues.en: So let's go back to deployments and this time let's use our classification deployed model.
cues.zh: 回 Deployments，用分類模型。

cues.en: Here we're going to click the three little dots.
cues.zh: 按三個點。

cues.en: We're going to click test deployment, and once again, we can enter some values of the breast.
cues.zh: Test deployment，再輸入特徵。

cues.en: Okay for example, I'm going to change the clump thickness to three.
cues.zh: 例如 Clump Thickness 改 3。

cues.en: I'm going to change the marginal addition to two, bland chromatin to five, and mitosis to three, okay?
cues.zh: Marginal Adhesion 改 2、Bland Chromatin 改 5、Mitosis 改 3。

cues.en: Just choosing some random numbers here.
cues.zh: 只是隨機選數字。

cues.en: And then once again, to get the prediction whether that particular patient with those particular breast features has a benign or malignant tumor, well, we can just click update prediction which
cues.zh: 要預測這位特徵如此的病患，腫瘤是否良惡性，按 Update prediction，

cues.en: actually invokes our deployed classification model to get that new prediction, and fortunately, this particular patient is predicted to have a benign tumor.
cues.zh: 實際呼叫已部署分類模型；幸好預測良性。

cues.en: Alright, great.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: And finally, I want to show you one last thing, which is how to find your endpoint within your SageMaker domain.
cues.zh: 最後展示，如何在 SageMaker 網域找到端點。

cues.en: So here we are in our user profile, remember in our domain user profile?
cues.zh: 目前是網域中的使用者設定檔，記得嗎？

cues.en: But you can find your deployed models in the form of endpoints here in the left hand panel.
cues.zh: 左側可找到以端點形式部署的模型。

cues.en: If you scroll down and then go there, you go to inference, just on the inference and then endpoints, of course, well, you'll find, there you go, your two endpoints, right?
cues.zh: 往下到 Inference，再 Endpoints，就有兩個端點。

cues.en: The one for regression and the one for classification.
cues.zh: 迴歸與分類各一。

cues.en: So for example, if we click this, well, we will get the same details as the ones we had before.
cues.zh: 例如點它，看到和先前相同細節。

cues.en: And once again, we have the endpoint URL, which allows you to basically call your deploy model whenever you want to use it in an application to make new predictions.
cues.zh: 再次看到 Endpoint URL，可在應用裡呼叫模型做新預測。

cues.en: And then here below, you have some operational metrics like the CPU utilization, memory utilization, disc utilization, GPU utilization, okay?
cues.zh: 下方還有維運指標，CPU、記憶體、磁碟、GPU 使用率。

cues.en: So there we go, that's it for this tutorial on deployment endpoints in SageMaker.
cues.zh: 這堂端點教學到此。

cues.en: Now you know how to find your endpoints.
cues.zh: 現在知道怎麼找端點。

cues.en: You know how to use them in a code, for example, and you know how to test them.
cues.zh: 怎麼在程式用，以及怎麼測。

cues.en: So let's move on to the next hands-on tutorial.
cues.zh: 進下一堂實作。

cues.en: I can't wait to see you there.
cues.zh: 迫不及待見到你。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning with AWS.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受 AWS 機器學習的樂趣吧。
